trigger: Compromise of a shared EHR, clinical cloud, identity or claims-processing service through credential or administration-plane abuse
propagation_mechanism: Common-mode loss: platform isolated so all dependent providers lose the function simultaneously
affected_sector_service: Scheduling, records access, e-prescribing, laboratory ordering, claims submission
plausible_effects: Provider revenue-cycle and cash-flow delay; vendor liability; mass notification and GDPR enforcement; bridging finance demand
early_warning_indicators: Vendor disclosures; ISAC identity alerts; regulator statements; ministerial intervention
assumptions: No named provider, duration or loss; concurrency is the defining feature
limitations: Not a forecast; offline modes and segmentation may limit effect

trigger: Ransomware or destructive intrusion forcing precautionary shutdown at a major hospital group, pathology or diagnostic provider
propagation_mechanism: Loss of EPR and laboratory systems forces paper operation; diversion of unstable patients and urgent work to neighbouring providers
affected_sector_service: Emergency capacity, elective surgery, imaging, laboratory results, payroll, ordering
plausible_effects: Activity revenue loss; overtime and recovery spend; public recovery funding; notification and fines; earnings or covenant pressure for leveraged operators
early_warning_indicators: Ransomware claims against regional providers; diversion notices; observatory degraded-mode data
assumptions: Single operator directly attacked; no assumption on attacker, duration or clinical outcome
limitations: Not a forecast; intact backups and mutual aid limit effect

trigger: Disruption or suspension of a manufacturer, distributor or outsourced laboratory serving many providers or a national programme
propagation_mechanism: Stock buffers deplete (about two weeks in the UK Stryker case); controlled allocation and mutual aid; rescheduled procedures; substitutes run above capacity until throughput is reduced; fourth-party element via supplier IT platform or another laboratory client
affected_sector_service: Implants, instruments, consumables, pharmaceutical packaging components, screening and pathology throughput
plausible_effects: Manufacturer revenue deferral and guidance changes; hospital activity deferral; substitute procurement cost; programme backlog funding
early_warning_indicators: SEC Item 1.05 filings; national supply notices; inspectorate findings on outsourced services
assumptions: No named supplier assumed to fail; combines documented mechanisms
limitations: Not a forecast; consigned inventory and multi-sourcing limit effect
